name: Medspa cold email campaign strategy
summary:
**Conversation Overview**

The person is building a marketing agency called The Luxora Collective, focused on growth marketing for medspas across the USA. They are working with a team that includes a colleague named Jacques. The conversation centered on adapting an existing cold email framework, drawn from a detailed internal training document, into a polished outreach sequence targeting medspa owners and medical directors nationwide.

The training document referenced a comprehensive outbound and inbound strategy covering campaign metrics, domain setup, lead sourcing tools (Clay, Apollo, D7 Lead Finder, Instantly, NeverBounce), GoHighLevel automation, risk reversal tactics, and cold email anatomy. Key campaign benchmarks included a 40% open rate target, 5% reply rate minimum, 80% call show-up rate, and 15+ booked calls per month.

Claude initially drafted emails leading with lead generation results, which the person corrected, clarifying they wanted the hook to be market research, not leads. After a second attempt, the person asked for the emails to be made more appealing and for a full 3-email sequence to be built out: Email 1 leading with local market research curiosity, Email 2 offering the Medspa Market Blueprint as a value drop, and Email 3 transitioning into a soft call-to-action with a calendar link. Claude delivered all three emails in that structure, following the framework rule of never including links in Email 1 and reserving the calendar link for Email 3.
